purpose: Teach: 中央アジア/外界/アルカイダ/ガザ/公爵/敗者/前世/難問

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中央アジア出身の患者の医療通訳を医療チームで手配します
lines.en: Ren, we'll arrange a medical interpreter for our Central Asian patient through the team.
lines.style: Clear, direct statement. Even breath. Professional but not distant. Slight pause before the patient detail, drawing focus to the specificity of the case.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、新生児の外界刺激への反応を医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Yes, we'll have the team observe the newborn's responses to external stimuli.
lines.style: Measured, reassuring tone. Steady pacing. A doctor explaining procedure without oversimplifying. Competent and unhurried.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、アルカイダ系紛争地からの傷病者を医療チームで受けます
lines.en: Ren, we're taking in casualties from the Al-Qaeda-affiliated conflict zone. The team will handle the medical response.
lines.style: Steady delivery, no flinch. Direct acknowledgment of the gravity. Professional composure that signals she has processed the weight of this already.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ガザ地区への医療支援を、貴院、ご検討されてますね、先生
lines.en: I notice your hospital is considering medical support for Gaza, Doctor.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful phrasing. Tentative — not quite a question, more an observation offered for response. Respectful distance. Slightly hesitant attack.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、公爵家ご子息の医療対応も医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes, the team will also coordinate the medical response for the Duke's son.
lines.style: Same professional cadence as before. Factual. No elevation of tone for the high-profile case — just another patient needing protocol.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療事故の敗者復活的再発防止策を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes, we're developing comprehensive measures to prevent recurrence of the medical error through team review.
lines.style: Firm, deliberate. A shift toward accountability language. Not defensive, but resolved. The word 'prevent' carries weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 前世療法という非科学的療法を、貴院、推奨されませんね、先生
lines.en: I gather your hospital doesn't recommend past-life therapy as a treatment approach, Doctor.
lines.style: Careful intellectual distance. Phrased as gentle observation rather than challenge. Slightly uncertain — testing the waters. Respectful skepticism.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医学の難問は医療チームで議論を重ねます
lines.en: Yes, our team works through the difficult medical questions together, discussion by discussion.
lines.style: Warm closing. Gentle emphasis on 'together' — collaborative rather than hierarchical. Slow, deliberate. Suggests the work is ongoing and shared.
